Our Plastering Services

Plastering and skimming, media walls, Venetian plaster and microcement, from Darren Denholm across Wishaw, Motherwell, Glasgow, North Lanarkshire and the Central Belt.

Call 07767 446273 WhatsApp Us
Plastering and SkimmingWalls and ceilings skimmed smooth in gypsum materials. A kitchen usually takes a day. Media WallsStud work plastered with sharp lines round the TV, fire and shelving. Usually 1 to 2 days. Venetian PlasterFeature walls from marble effects to pitted stone, trained with Venezia Stucco. MicrocementSeamless, waterproof floors, walls and bathrooms, trained and approved by Luna Plaster.
Plaster Repairs and PatchingHoles and chases left by a rewire or plumbing work made good, ready to decorate.
Commercial PlasteringPlastering for offices and fit-outs, including work for joinery firms.

Repairs and Commercial Work

As well as the four above, Darren makes good the holes and chases left by rewires and plumbing work, and takes on plastering for offices and fit-outs. Ask when you call.

Not sure which one you need?

Tell Darren what the room is and what finish you are after, and he will talk you through the options.
